3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:ce957fc8-6646.description: Launch and Grow Your Own ABA Practice — with Zero Upfront Costs Join 3Y Health and earn $100,000 - $320,000/year while making your own schedule. Tired of rigid clinical environments and professional burnout? Looking to build a practice and don’t know where to start? At 3Y Health, we believe BCBAs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where you can launch and grow your own ABA practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/autism-therapy-aba What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you, your RBTs, and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re in-network with 100+ payers at high market rates, giving you broad access to patients. - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own ABA company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you and your RBTs if you’d like. Your Role: - Own and operate your practice – Set your hours, select clients, and define how you deliver care. - Hire and lead your RBTs – Build a team that aligns with your vision. - Deliver exceptional ABA therapy – You’re the expert. We give you the platform to thrive. Why BCBAs Love 3Y Health: - 100% autonomy with zero admin headaches - Real earning potential with no financial risk - Flexible work-from-anywhere model - Make a bigger impact without burning out

assistworld-assist-world:lever:cded239a-.description: We are looking for an experienced Construction Billing & Bookkeeping Specialist to join a growing business and take ownership of billing, accounts receivable, and bookkeeping support. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a strong understanding of construction billing processes, particularly AIA billing (Forms 702 and 703), progress billing, and change orders. You’ll work closely with customers and internal teams, so strong communication skills and a professional, relationship-focused approach are essential. The role will initially be 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase to full-time as the business grows and the successful candidate demonstrates their capabilities. Key Responsibilities ● Prepare and manage AIA billing, including Forms 702 and 703 ● Handle construction progress billing and ensure invoices are accurate and submitted on time ● Process and track change orders ● Manage accounts receivable and monitor outstanding balances ● Follow up with customers regarding outstanding invoices and payments ● Maintain accurate financial records and documentation ● Support bookkeeping activities using QuickBooks Online (QBO) ● Update and manage customer and project information within Salesforce ● Reconcile billing information and identify discrepancies ● Work closely with customers to resolve billing queries professionally ● Assist with maintaining efficient billing and accounting processes ● Provide general administrative support related to billing and bookkeeping as required

jobgether-jobgether:lever:12c26688-7938-.title: Technical Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:12c26688-7938-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Account Manager based in Ireland. As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a strategic and technical partner to large enterprise customers throughout their entire journey. You will guide customers from onboarding and implementation through long-term adoption, retention, and expansion. The role combines technical expertise, project management, customer success, and consultative problem-solving. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Engineering, and other teams to deliver solutions that create measurable customer value. Your curiosity and ability to understand complex data environments will help customers get the most from a sophisticated technology platform. You will also bring customer feedback and emerging use cases back to internal teams to influence product evolution. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-moving, collaborative, and technology-driven environment. Own the technical customer journey from kickoff and onboarding through ongoing success, adoption, retention, and expansion. Manage and execute customer-facing technical projects, ensuring onboarding activities are well organized, timely, and aligned with customer objectives. Build strong relationships with enterprise customers and develop a deep understanding of their business requirements, technical environments, use cases, and challenges. Provide proactive technical guidance and recommend best practices to help customers maximize the value and adoption of the platform. Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities to increase platform adoption and support the growth of strategic accounts. Collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other internal teams to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and escalations. Translate customer requirements into practical, efficient solutions while helping customers navigate complex technical systems. Identify emerging customer use cases, recurring challenges, and product opportunities, and communicate these insights to Engineering and other product teams. Serve as a trusted advisor who can balance technical depth with business priorities and customer outcomes. Manage competing priorities, deadlines, and unexpected roadblocks while maintaining a high standard of customer service. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in a client-facing and/or technology-focused role combining strong business understanding with technical expertise. Demonstrated experience managing and delivering technical projects with a customer-first mindset and strong empathy for customer needs. Excellent project management, organization, written communication, and verbal communication skills. Strong ability to quickly learn new technologies and understand complex technical environments, including SQL, databases, APIs, reporting tools, and related systems. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with a genuine interest in continuously developing technical expertise. Ability to understand customer requirements at a detailed level and translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders with different technical backgrounds and responsibilities. Ability to remain composed and effective under pressure, manage deadlines, and navigate unexpected challenges with confidence. A customer-oriented, curious, proactive, and consultative approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Willingness and ability to work in a fast-paced technology environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Benefits: Competitive compensation package. Meaningful equity compensation through ISO options. Early exercise opportunities for eligible equity. 10-year post-termination exercise window for equity

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b556509d-0dd9-.title: Head of Data Center Design
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b556509d-0dd9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Data Center Design based in Ireland. As Head of Data Center Design, you will take ownership of the technical vision and architecture for a major next-generation AI data center development in Europe. You’ll lead design decisions across power, cooling, IT infrastructure, fire protection, networking, and structural considerations. The role offers significant technical influence, from early site feasibility and concept development through detailed engineering and construction execution. You’ll establish the Basis of Design and ensure that multidisciplinary teams remain aligned with performance, capacity, efficiency, and reliability objectives. Working with technology partners and implementation teams, you’ll ensure approved designs translate effectively into real-world infrastructure. The environment is international, technically complex, and focused on large-scale, high-density compute infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape a critical infrastructure project designed to support the rapidly growing demands of AI and advanced computing. Own the overall technical design, architecture, and engineering vision for large-scale data center facilities. Define and maintain the Basis of Design , covering modular POD architecture, cooling strategy, power topology, fire suppression, networking, and other critical infrastructure requirements. Establish design standards for IT deployment, including rack layouts, containerization approaches, and CDU placement. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews and approve engineering drawings across electrical, mechanical, structural, fire protection, and networking disciplines. Establish and monitor design-stage targets for PUE, capacity, availability, redundancy, and reliability . Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and engineering partners on technical specifications and integration requirements. Work closely with implementation and construction teams to ensure that physical execution remains aligned with the approved design intent. Assess and approve proposed design changes, evaluating their potential impact on cooling, power, capacity, redundancy, performance, and reliability. Lead technical criteria for site selection and feasibility assessments, including power availability, grid connectivity, cooling options, and other infrastructure considerations. Provide technical leadership throughout the design lifecycle and ensure consistent engineering standards across projects and disciplines. Requirements 5+ years of experience in data center design or in the design of critical infrastructure, industrial, energy, or similarly complex facilities ; direct data center experience is highly valued but not mandatory. Demonstrated ownership of, or significant contribution to, Basis of Design documentation for large-scale facilities. At least 3 years of experience in a design leadership or technical leadership position. Strong technical knowledge of power distribution/topology and cooling strategies , with sufficient working knowledge of fire suppression and structural loading to coordinate effectively across disciplines. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and reviewing or approving engineering drawings across multiple technical trades. Strong ability to translate technical requirements into clear design standards, decisions, and execution requirements. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with engineering teams, technology partners, suppliers, and construction teams. Professional English proficiency sufficient for international technical documentation, meetings, and stakeholder communication. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f78ee6bf-d609-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Java System Architect based in Brazil. This is a strategic architecture role focused on modernizing and evolving mission-critical applications within the insurance sector. You will shape complex solution architectures while balancing scalability, resilience, performance, security, and business value. The role combines hands-on technical leadership with architectural governance and long-term modernization strategy. You will work closely with engineering squads, architects, business stakeholders, and enterprise clients to drive key technical decisions. todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:09eba9.title: Accounts Payable Assistant- Fixed Term Contract
todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:09eba9.description: About TodayTix Group: TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. Life at TodayTix Group We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. About the Role: We're looking for an organised, proactive Accounts Payable Assistant to join our Finance team. You'll help keep our supplier relationships strong, our payments accurate, and our accounts payable (AP) processes modern as we scale — work that directly affects how reliably we pay our theatre and events partners. Reporting to the AP Lead in London, you'll work closely with colleagues across the business as well as our external vendors and partners — so strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative, positive nature matter as much as technical accuracy. This is a great opportunity for someone with a few years of AP experience who wants to grow within a tech-driven company. We're partway through migrating our finance systems from NetSuite to SAP S/4HANA, and increasingly using AI and automation to cut down on manual, repetitive accounts payable (AP) work. If you're curious about how these tools can make your job easier, and comfortable with change, we'd love to hear from you. Bonus points if you're excited about theatre and events too! Please note: This is an initial 9-month contract and qualified candidates must be based in the greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, while also offering flexibility for employees to choose where they work for the rest of the week.
